title: coord.py claim, dedup and release leave the events a harness counts: a real research agent's claim window, a refused claim and a dedup's result
goal: claim_windows (bench_multi.py) finds the window of a research key that coord.py claim then coord.py release left in a store, with no hand-posted claim or release event; a claim the store refuses leaves an event naming its key and holder; and coord.py dedup leaves an event with its holder, topic, claimed, overlapping and held terms, so a run's claims, refused claims and dedup hits are read after the agents released their keys

gates.question: Which coord.py claims leave events (taken, given back, refused): every key, or only research keys and backlog item keys, keeping the session presence leases the coord hook renews out of the event log?
options: research and item keys only, no session leases
gates.recommendation: research and item keys only, no session leases
gates.answer: research and item keys only, no session leases

notes: Review of SP-7s6uubs7, S2: coord.py claim and release post no events and a released row is deleted, so only the replay's hand-posted events make the duplicate-research check fire (bench_multi.py claim_windows). Premise run 2026-10-19 on origin/main 7079b184a: two coord.py dedup calls and a third holder on a planted store posted no event at all (sqlite3 events table empty), and the check below fails with 'a claimed and released research key leaves no claim window'. Cause of claims=0 in every SP-3pvz2noj row: coord_counts reads entries after the run, and release deletes a released row, so a claim the agents made and released (sandbox 3c0dfd52 agent3, 51188732 agent3, 858a5dbd agent2 and agent3: four research keys each, released) counts 0.
